name: akmalariq-portfolio
description: akmalariq.dev — static portfolio + blog, deployed to Cloudflare Pages

scripts.build:blog: node scripts/sync-tokens.mjs && cd blog-src && npm ci --no-audit --no-fund && npm run build
scripts.build: npm run check:structure && npm run build:blog && npm run build:site
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npx wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name akmalariq --branch main
